zh: 控制中心新增「一键极速释放内存」，实时掌握可用内存并秒速清理后台
控制中心新增「实时网速测速与网络诊断」，实时测算下载带宽、延迟与 4K 播放评级
控制中心新增「开机直达指定应用」，开机自动拉起指定 App，按 Home 键随时回桌面
控制中心新增「遥控器快捷按键自定义」，支持数字键 0-9、四色键一键直达 App
商城安装包生命周期管理：安装完成即刻清理 APK，进入商城自动删除过期历史安装包
自定义布局备份增加 10 个安全上限保护与超额友好提醒，防止卡顿与存储膨胀
优化首页公告走马灯：加宽胶囊并消除停顿感，实现从头到尾无缝连贯匀速滚动
en: Added Memory Boost to Control Center for instant background cleanup
Added Network Speed Test & Diagnostics with real-time bandwidth and latency
Added Boot App setting to launch designated app directly on startup
Added Remote Key Customization for 0-9 and color shortcut keys
App Store APK lifecycle management: auto-delete on install and periodic cleanup
Added 10-backup limit guard for custom layouts with friendly prompts
Optimized marquee: seamless continuous scrolling without pause and widened capsule

zh: 默认壁纸升级为「跟随 App」灵动光晕，根据选中图标自动流动变色
优化全局文案与品牌标识为 HMTV
en: Default wallpaper updated to Follow App ambient glow
Branding updated to HMTV

zh: 更名为「HMTV桌面」，内置统一签名全面支持各端一键覆盖安装
优化文件夹退出退场动画与焦点防抖，提升退出流畅度
en: Renamed to 'HMTV Launcher', unified signing with seamless overwrite install support
Smoother folder exit animation and focus debounce

zh: 优化系统级桌面升级机制，支持直接覆盖更新
优化文件夹退出退场动画与焦点防抖，提升退出流畅度
en: Optimized system launcher update mechanism to support direct package updates
Smoother folder exit animation and focus debounce

zh: 控制中心新增「应用商城」，支持浏览与一键下载云端热门应用
首页顶部新增滚动公告走马灯，实时获取云端公告与客服微信支持
个性化设置中支持自主开启或关闭首页滚动公告
en: Added App Store to Control Center with one-click app downloads
Added top scrolling announcement marquee for cloud notices and WeChat support
Personalization settings option to toggle scrolling marquee on or off

zh: 应用更名为「HMTV桌面启动器」，守护服务更名为「HMTV 桌面守护」
内置锁定官方默认布局（涵盖影视、游戏、工具、娱乐、系统应用），保护不可删除
预设文件夹名称增加「娱乐」分类
优化 Wi-Fi 连接：密码默认明文显示、遥控器按「下」直达连接按钮、异步稳定握手
默认屏幕保护程序类型设置为「航拍」
支持特权系统级部署（/system/priv-app/），防止被用户卸载
每次版本升级后自动解除个性化密码与家长锁定，防止遗忘密码导致锁定
en: Renamed app to 'HMTV桌面启动器' (HMTV Launcher)
Built-in official locked default layout (Movies, Games, Tools, Entertainment, System)
Added 'Entertainment' to folder name presets
Optimized Wi-Fi: plain text password by default, D-pad down directly focuses Connect, async connection
Default screensaver set to Aerial
Support privileged system app deployment (/system/priv-app/) to prevent uninstallation
Automatically reset personalization PIN on upgrade to prevent accidental lockout
